a sprite sheet for a cartoon office automation puzzle game, chunky stylized game art, bold dark outlines, front view. 4 columns and 1 row: a cute small worker robot with one big eye holding nothing; the same robot holding a box above its head; an inbox conveyor belt machine with a green arrow; an outbox conveyor belt machine with a red arrow. arranged in a strict even grid with wide empty gaps between items, every item fully inside its own cell and centered, nothing overlapping, fully transparent background (real PNG alpha), no text, no letters, no numbers, no grid lines

a sprite sheet of logic circuit puzzle parts, clean stylized game art, bold dark outlines, front view. 4 columns and 2 rows: a toggle switch in the off position; the same toggle switch in the on position glowing green; a light bulb turned off; the same light bulb glowing bright yellow; an AND gate block (D shape, grey); an OR gate block (curved shield shape, grey); a NOT gate block (triangle with a small circle, grey); an XOR gate block (curved shape with an extra curved line, grey). arranged in a strict even grid with wide empty gaps between items, every item fully inside its own cell and centered, nothing overlapping, fully transparent background (real PNG alpha), no text, no letters, no numbers, no grid lines
